representation.name: Extract 1000G candidate SNP genotypes with bcftools
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
VCF_URL='https://ftp.1000genomes.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/ftp/data_collections/1000G_2504_high_coverage/working/20201028_3202_raw_GT_with_annot/20201028_CCDG_14151_B01_GRM_WGS_2020-08-05_chr1.recalibrated_variants.vcf.gz'
bcftools view -R "$(inputs.regions.path)" -Ov "$VCF_URL" | perl "$(inputs.script.path)" "$(inputs.regions.path)" genotypes.tsv answer_summary.txt final_report.txt
